questions.stem: A 73-year-old man presented to the emergency room with slurred speech, vertigo, and incoordination. Exam showed dysarthria, left beating nystagmus, decreased sensation in the left face and right trunk/limbs, and left upper extremity ataxia. Head CT was normal but Brain MRI revealed a medullary infarct. On hospital day 2 he had to be transferred to the ICU for repeated episodes of prolonged central apneas during sleep. Which structures may have been damaged to result in this complication?

options.label: A
options.text: The dorsal and ventral respiratory groups
